about: Every gameplay system. 'side' is where it runs; 'uses' lists rows of other sheets it depends on (sheet:id).

rows.trigger: client mod init, before the first resource reload
rows.does: reads the player's Scrap Mechanic textures and names and No Man's Sky music and writes them into a resource pack folder in the instance (scrapsky/runtime-pack) that is always on top

rows.trigger: first player joins a world that has no wreck yet
rows.does: builds the crash-landed starter ship 8 blocks from spawn on the surface: metal floor, glass canopy, caution trim, driver's seat, one working and one broken thruster

rows.trigger: use a Broken Thruster while carrying 3 iron ingots and 2 redstone
rows.does: takes the materials and turns it into a working Thruster

collects every Scrap Sky part touching the seat (up to 1024), needs total lift >= total mass and at least one Thruster, removes them from the world and turns them into one flying Ship entity with the player in the seat

rows.trigger: each tick while a player rides the Ship
rows.does: W/S fly forward/back, A/D turn, Jump climbs, Sprint descends; speed = 0.9 * min(1, lift/mass) blocks per tick; no gravity while piloted
snaps the ship to the block grid and a quarter turn, places every block back if all spots are free; otherwise keeps it hovering and says 'Find open ground to land'
freezes the ship and opens the Star Map screen listing Home and three planets with their generated names and No Man's Sky descriptors; picking one moves ship and pilot there at y=230

rows.trigger: a ship arrives at a planet
rows.does: shows the planet's name as a title and its descriptor and weather as subtitle; the planet's biome plays No Man's Sky music

rows.trigger: a single-player world finishes loading and melty.properties has an empty join
rows.does: opens the world to others through the bundled e4mc relay and writes 'Melty join address: <domain>' to melty.log once e4mc logs 'Domain assigned: '

rows.trigger: the title screen first opens and melty.properties has join=<address>
rows.does: connects straight to the host and writes 'Melty joined: <address>' once in
turns away a fifth player with 'This Scrap Sky world is full (4 players)'
